lead_raw_text:
The structure of Sr4Al2O6 (Sr2AlO3) crystallizes in the trigonal space group R-3m (No. 166), with 12 atoms in the unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Al centers in octahedral coordination by six O neighbors, while Sr centers adopt an octahedral environment with six O neighbors and O centers coordinate to three Al atoms. The Al-centered octahedra share edges, and Al–Sr octahedra share corners and edges, forming a three-dimensional connectivity network.
